description: Dates for Volume III-IV documents whose editorial heading is missing, OCR-damaged, or too broad (a bare year). Keys are the document's Roman numeral. Each entry replaces the heading date for the whole document.

CCVIII.basis: Heading reads only 1622; Wroth's notes count the colonists 'about the tyme of the Massacre' and the 3000 lost, so they postdate 22 March 1622.

CCX.basis: Waterhouse's Declaration (heading: 1622) is the printed relation of the 22 March 1622 attack, so it postdates the attack.
